title: Knowledge Usage Record
description: Records when a knowledge entry was retrieved and whether it helped.

entry_id.description: ID of the knowledge entry that was used.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 when the entry was used.

context_slice_id.description: Slice ID of the task where this entry was used.

outcome.description: Did the knowledge entry help solve the problem?

notes.description: Optional notes about why it helped or didn't.
